_meta.name: mmm_bayes
_meta.description: Bayesian media-mix model over one market's weekly series: FILTER_INCLUDE keeps the east market (the model fits one contiguous series; several markets per week are refused as duplicate_time), and ONE REG_MMM_BAYES adstocks the four raw spend channels inside the model (geometric, 13-week window), fits each channel's Hill curve, ROI and decay jointly with price and promo as linear controls, and samples the posterior with NUTS. The chains are kept short for a quick run (2 chains of 300 warmup + 200 draws, so the fit carries ess_low diagnostic warnings; drop them for the 4 × (1000 + 1000) default), rng_seed pins the draws, and holdout_from 92 holds the last 13 weeks out of the likelihood while the adstock still runs over the full history. The coefficients are posterior means with posterior SDs; outputs.roi / mroi / contribution give each channel's credible intervals, outputs.diagnostics the sampler health and outputs.holdout the held-out RMSE and interval coverage.
